source_snippets.environment:
extends RefCounted
## Shared three-phase light rig; light changes never rebuild geometry or PCM.
var environment: Environment
var sky_material: ProceduralSkyMaterial
var sun: DirectionalLight3D
var view_pitch := 0.8
var current_phase := 0

func setup(parent: Node3D) -> void:
	var world := WorldEnvironment.new()
	world.name = "ValleyEnvironment"
	environment = Environment.new()
	sky_material = ProceduralSkyMaterial.new()
	var sky := Sky.new()
	sky.sky_material = sky_material
	environment.background_mode = Environment.BG_COLOR
	environment.sky = sky
	environment.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_SKY
	environment.ambient_light_sky_contribution = 0.52
	environment.ssao_enabled = true
	environment.ssao_radius = 0.75
	environment.ssao_intensity = 1.15
	environment.ssao_power = 1.25
	environment.ssao_detail = 0.5
	environment.ssao_light_affect = 0.14
	environment.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_FILMIC
	environment.tonemap_white = 2.35
	world.environment = environment
	parent.add_child(world)
	sun = DirectionalLight3D.new()
	sun.directional_shadow_mode = DirectionalLight3D.SHADOW_PARALLEL_2_SPLITS
	sun.directional_shadow_split_1 = 0.26
	sun.directional_shadow_blend_splits = true
	sun.shadow_normal_bias = 1.15
	sun.shadow_opacity = 0.82
	sun.shadow_blur = 1.1
	sun.shadow_enabled = true
	sun.directional_shadow_max_distance = 92.0
	sun.shadow_bias = 0.018
	parent.add_child(sun)
	apply(0)

func apply(phase: int) -> void:
	current_phase = clampi(phase, 0, 2)
	# [sky_top, sky_horizon, bg_color, sun_color, sun_energy, amb_energy, exposure, sun_rot, amb_color, white, shadow_op]
	var row: Array = [
		["5892c4", "e6dec8", "d0e0dc", "fff4e0", 1.12, 0.44, 0.80, Vector3(-48, -36, 0), "bfd4e6", 2.35, 0.82],
		["435f8c", "eb9e78", "b59b94", "ffae68", 1.02, 0.38, 0.86, Vector3(-19, -52, 0), "8a86a6", 2.20, 0.80],
		["101c2e", "1e3148", "152436", "6484b0", 0.22, 0.20, 1.02, Vector3(-42,  28, 0), "22334d", 1.95, 0.70]
	][current_phase]
	sky_material.sky_top_color = Color(row[0])
	sky_material.sky_horizon_color = Color(row[1])
	sky_material.ground_horizon_color = Color(row[1]).darkened(0.16)
	sky_material.ground_bottom_color = Color("6e7464").darkened(0.50 if current_phase == 2 else 0.0)
	environment.background_color = Color(row[2])
	environment.ambient_light_color = Color(row[8])
	environment.ambient_light_energy = row[5]
	environment.tonemap_exposure = row[6]
	environment.tonemap_white = row[9]
	sun.light_color = Color(row[3])
	sun.light_energy = row[4]
	sun.rotation_degrees = row[7]
	sun.shadow_opacity = row[10]
	set_view(view_pitch)

func set_view(pitch: float) -> void:
	view_pitch = pitch
	var low := 1.0 - smoothstep(0.18, 0.55, pitch)
	# 常驻轻度远景空气透视，拉开 80m 建造区、河湾与 160m 远山的空间层次
	environment.fog_enabled = true
	environment.fog_mode = Environment.FOG_MODE_DEPTH
	environment.fog_depth_begin = lerpf(38.0, 22.0, low)
	environment.fog_depth_end = lerpf(225.0, 145.0, low)
	environment.fog_depth_curve = 1.85
	var haze_colors := [Color("cadbe0"), Color("cfa092"), Color("182638")]
	environment.fog_light_color = haze_colors[current_phase]
	environment.fog_light_energy = [0.52, 0.60, 0.45][current_phase]
	environment.fog_sky_affect = 0.0
source_snippets.wall_material_source:
extends RefCounted
const WallShader := preload("res://scripts/visual/shaders/creation_wall.gdshader")
enum Kind { PLASTER, STONE, TERRACOTTA, SLATE, CANTILEVER, TIMBER, METAL }

static func source(color: Color, texture: Texture2D = null, style: String = "classic", kind: int = Kind.PLASTER) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	material.albedo_color = color
	material.albedo_texture = texture
	material.texture_filter = BaseMaterial3D.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS
	material.texture_repeat = true
	if style == "stone" and texture != null:
		material.uv1_scale = Vector3(0.68, 0.68, 0.68)
	material.roughness = 0.96 if style == "stone" else (0.62 if kind == Kind.TIMBER else (0.38 if kind == Kind.METAL else 0.90))
	material.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED if style == "stone" else BaseMaterial3D.CULL_BACK
	material.set_meta("creation_wall", true)
	material.set_meta("creation_wall_style", style)
	material.set_meta("creation_surface_kind", kind)
	return material

source_parameter_rows.claimed_effect: 解除日间灰暗欠曝，拉开受光与背光明暗对比
保护高曝光下暖白石灰墙的抹刀细节不过曝死白
建立“暖阳受光 vs 冷青背光”的水彩体积感
衬托 `#ffae68` 金珀斜阳与暖窗灯光
压暗夜空底色，凸显万家灯火、路灯与水面灯影
消除窗楣、檐口、石阶的阴影脱离（Peter-panning）
恢复石材、木材、陶瓦、板岩、铜铁的真实光泽差异
分离灰泥横纹、石缝凹槽、顺纹木纤维与古铜绿锈
